#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Validate and summarize raw PR #8 full-clip Go/dav1d refresh artifacts."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

EXPECTED_CLIPS = 18
FRAMES_PER_CLIP = 48
EXPECTED_FRAMES = EXPECTED_CLIPS * FRAMES_PER_CLIP
EXPECTED_BACKEND_VERSION = "1.5.3"
GO_ROW_RE = re.compile(
    r"public_fullclip clip=(\S+) frames=(\d+) "
    r"cold_fresh_decoder_median=(\S+) cold_samples=\[([^\]]+)\] "
    r"cold_payload_decoder_median=(\S+) cold_payload_samples=\[([^\]]+)\] "
    r"warm_reset_decode_median=(\S+) warm_samples=\[([^\]]+)\] sink=(\d+)"
)
GO_MD5_RE = re.compile(
    r"public MD5 verified: clip=(\S+) frames=(\d+) digest=([0-9a-f]{32})"
)
GO_PAYLOAD_MD5_RE = re.compile(
    r"public payload constructor MD5 verified: clip=(\S+) frames=(\d+) digest=([0-9a-f]{32})"
)
DURATION_RE = re.compile(r"^([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(ns|µs|us|ms|s)$")


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def ns_from_duration(text: str) -> int:
    match = DURATION_RE.fullmatch(text.strip())
    require(match is not None, f"unrecognized Go duration: {text!r}")
    amount = Decimal(match.group(1))
    unit = match.group(2)
    scale = {
        "ns": Decimal(1),
        "µs": Decimal(1_000),
        "us": Decimal(1_000),
        "ms": Decimal(1_000_000),
        "s": Decimal(1_000_000_000),
    }[unit]
    return int((amount * scale).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))


def parse_go_samples(raw: str, label: str) -> list[int]:
    values = [ns_from_duration(value.strip()) for value in raw.split(",") if value.strip()]
    require(len(values) == 9, f"{label}: expected nine raw samples, got {len(values)}")
    require(all(value > 0 for value in values), f"{label}: raw samples must be positive")
    return values


def parse_go_log(path: Path, expected_names: set[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, str]]:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    require(text.rstrip().endswith("PASS"), f"{path}: Go test log does not end in PASS")
    require(
        text.count("public decoder MD5 preflight passed: clips=18 frames=864 workers=1") == 1,
        f"{path}: missing or duplicate 18-clip Go preflight marker",
    )
    require(
        text.count("sample protocol: workers=1 warmups=1 samples=9;") == 1,
        f"{path}: missing or duplicate one-warmup/nine-sample protocol marker",
    )

    rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        match = GO_ROW_RE.search(line)
        if not match:
            continue
        name, frame_text, cold_median, cold_raw, payload_median, payload_raw, warm_median, warm_raw, sink = match.groups()
        require(name not in rows, f"{path}: duplicate Go clip row {name}")
        frames = int(frame_text)
        require(frames == FRAMES_PER_CLIP, f"{path}: {name} has {frames} frames")
        cold_samples = parse_go_samples(cold_raw, f"{path} {name} cold IVF")
        payload_samples = parse_go_samples(payload_raw, f"{path} {name} cold payload")
        warm_samples = parse_go_samples(warm_raw, f"{path} {name} warm")
        cold_median_ns = ns_from_duration(cold_median)
        payload_median_ns = ns_from_duration(payload_median)
        warm_median_ns = ns_from_duration(warm_median)
        require(statistics.median(cold_samples) == cold_median_ns, f"{path}: {name} cold median disagrees with raw samples")
        require(statistics.median(payload_samples) == payload_median_ns, f"{path}: {name} payload median disagrees with raw samples")
        require(statistics.median(warm_samples) == warm_median_ns, f"{path}: {name} warm median disagrees with raw samples")
        rows[name] = {
            "frames": frames,
            "cold_samples_ns": cold_samples,
            "cold_median_ns": cold_median_ns,
            "cold_payload_samples_ns": payload_samples,
            "cold_payload_median_ns": payload_median_ns,
            "warm_reset_samples_ns": warm_samples,
            "warm_reset_median_ns": warm_median_ns,
            "sink": int(sink),
        }

    require(len(rows) == EXPECTED_CLIPS, f"{path}: expected 18 Go clip rows, got {len(rows)}")
    require(set(rows) == expected_names, f"{path}: Go clip rows do not match corpus names")

    def parse_md5_rows(pattern: re.Pattern[str], label: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        found: dict[str, str] = {}
        for line in text.splitlines():
            match = pattern.search(line)
            if not match:
                continue
            name, frame_text, digest = match.groups()
            require(int(frame_text) == FRAMES_PER_CLIP, f"{path}: {label} {name} has wrong frame count")
            require(name not in found, f"{path}: duplicate {label} row for {name}")
            found[name] = digest
        require(len(found) == EXPECTED_CLIPS, f"{path}: expected 18 {label} rows, got {len(found)}")
        require(set(found) == expected_names, f"{path}: {label} rows do not match corpus names")
        return found

    go_md5 = parse_md5_rows(GO_MD5_RE, "Go IVF MD5")
    payload_md5 = parse_md5_rows(GO_PAYLOAD_MD5_RE, "Go payload MD5")
    require(go_md5 == payload_md5, f"{path}: Go IVF and payload preflight MD5s differ")
    return rows, go_md5


def parse_c_log(path: Path, expected_names: set[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    raw_lines = [line for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for line_number, line in enumerate(raw_lines, start=1):
        try:
            records.append(json.loads(line))
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}:{line_number}: invalid JSONL: {exc}") from exc

    metadata = [record for record in records if record.get("type") == "metadata"]
    require(len(metadata) == 1, f"{path}: expected exactly one C metadata row, got {len(metadata)}")
    meta = metadata[0]
    require(meta.get("schema") == "goav1-c-api-decode-v1", f"{path}: unexpected C output schema")
    require(meta.get("backend") == "dav1d", f"{path}: C backend is not dav1d")
    require(meta.get("backend_version") == EXPECTED_BACKEND_VERSION, f"{path}: expected dav1d 1.5.3")
    require(meta.get("decoder_threads") == 1, f"{path}: C decoder_threads is not 1")
    require(meta.get("settings", {}).get("threads") == 1, f"{path}: C settings.threads is not 1")
    require(meta.get("run_mode") == "sample", f"{path}: C run_mode is not sample")
    require(meta.get("warmups") == 1 and meta.get("samples") == 9, f"{path}: C sample protocol is not one warmup and nine samples")
    require(meta.get("profile_repetitions") == 0, f"{path}: unexpected C profile-repeat mode")
    require(meta.get("timings_collected") is True, f"{path}: C timing samples were not collected")
    require(meta.get("clips") == EXPECTED_CLIPS, f"{path}: C metadata clips is not 18")
    require(meta.get("expected_full_corpus_visible_frames") == EXPECTED_FRAMES, f"{path}: C metadata frame count is not 864")
    require(meta.get("full_corpus_protocol") is True, f"{path}: C full-corpus protocol is false")
    require(meta.get("backend_source_checkout_commit_verified") is False, f"{path}: dav1d source provenance unexpectedly changed")
    require(meta.get("backend_binary_provenance_verified") is False, f"{path}: dav1d binary provenance unexpectedly changed")

    rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for record in records:
        if record.get("type") == "metadata":
            continue
        require(record.get("type") == "clip", f"{path}: unexpected record type {record.get('type')!r}")
        name = record.get("name")
        require(isinstance(name, str) and name, f"{path}: clip row has no name")
        require(name not in rows, f"{path}: duplicate C clip row {name}")
        require(record.get("sidecar_check") == "match", f"{path}: {name} sidecar did not match")
        require(record.get("preflight_md5") == record.get("sidecar_md5"), f"{path}: {name} preflight MD5 differs from sidecar")
        require(
            isinstance(record.get("preflight_md5"), str)
            and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", record["preflight_md5"]),
            f"{path}: {name} has invalid MD5",
        )
        require(record.get("visible_frames") == FRAMES_PER_CLIP, f"{path}: {name} frame count is not 48")
        require(isinstance(record.get("warmup_ns"), int) and record["warmup_ns"] > 0, f"{path}: {name} invalid warmup duration")
        samples = record.get("samples_ns")
        require(isinstance(samples, list) and len(samples) == 9, f"{path}: {name} expected nine C samples")
        require(all(isinstance(value, int) and value > 0 for value in samples), f"{path}: {name} has invalid C raw samples")
        require(record.get("median_ns") == statistics.median(samples), f"{path}: {name} C raw median disagrees with samples")
        observed = record.get("sample_observed")
        require(isinstance(observed, list) and len(observed) == 9 and len(set(observed)) == 1, f"{path}: {name} C observation totals differ")
        require(
            isinstance(record.get("preflight_observed"), str)
            and record["preflight_observed"].isdigit()
            and observed[0] == record["preflight_observed"],
            f"{path}: {name} sampled observer differs from preflight",
        )
        require(record.get("ivf_sha256") and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", record["ivf_sha256"]), f"{path}: {name} invalid IVF SHA-256")
        rows[name] = record

    require(len(rows) == EXPECTED_CLIPS, f"{path}: expected 18 C clip rows, got {len(rows)}")
    require(set(rows) == expected_names, f"{path}: C clip rows do not match corpus names")
    return meta, rows


def run_record(run_dir: Path, name: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    path = run_dir / name
    require(path.is_file(), f"missing raw artifact: {path}")
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": sha256_file(path)}


def round_data(go_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], c_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], go_md5: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, int]]:
    require(set(go_rows) == set(c_rows) == set(go_md5), "backend clip name sets differ")
    per_clip: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for name in sorted(go_rows):
        go = go_rows[name]
        c = c_rows[name]
        require(go["frames"] == c["visible_frames"] == FRAMES_PER_CLIP, f"{name}: backend frame counts differ")
        require(go_md5[name] == c["sidecar_md5"] == c["preflight_md5"], f"{name}: Go/C/sidecar MD5s differ")
        per_clip[name] = {
            "frames": FRAMES_PER_CLIP,
            "go_cold_ivf_samples_ns": go["cold_samples_ns"],
            "go_cold_ivf_median_ns": go["cold_median_ns"],
            "dav1d_samples_ns": c["samples_ns"],
            "dav1d_median_ns": c["median_ns"],
            "go_over_dav1d_ratio": go["cold_median_ns"] / c["median_ns"],
            "go_cold_preparsed_payload_samples_ns": go["cold_payload_samples_ns"],
            "go_cold_preparsed_payload_median_ns": go["cold_payload_median_ns"],
            "go_warm_reset_samples_ns": go["warm_reset_samples_ns"],
            "go_warm_reset_median_ns": go["warm_reset_median_ns"],
            "go_observation_sink": go["sink"],
            "ivf_sha256": c["ivf_sha256"],
            "sidecar_md5": c["sidecar_md5"],
        }

    sums = {
        "go_cold_ivf": sum(row["go_cold_ivf_median_ns"] for row in per_clip.values()),
        "dav1d": sum(row["dav1d_median_ns"] for row in per_clip.values()),
        "go_cold_preparsed_payload": sum(row["go_cold_preparsed_payload_median_ns"] for row in per_clip.values()),
        "go_warm_reset": sum(row["go_warm_reset_median_ns"] for row in per_clip.values()),
    }
    return per_clip, sums


def git_value(repo_root: Path, *args: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), *args],
            check=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        return None
    return result.stdout.strip()


def maybe_json(path: Path) -> Any | None:
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
        return None


def runtime_dav1d_info(helper: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(["otool", "-L", str(helper)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as exc:
        return {"otool_error": str(exc)}
    linked_path = None
    for line in result.stdout.splitlines()[1:]:
        candidate = line.strip().split(" (compatibility version", 1)[0]
        if "libdav1d" in candidate:
            linked_path = candidate
            break
    info: dict[str, Any] = {"linked_path": linked_path}
    if linked_path:
        resolved = Path(linked_path).resolve()
        info["resolved_path"] = str(resolved)
        if resolved.is_file():
            info["sha256"] = sha256_file(resolved)
    return info


def copy_record(path: Path, run_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    record: dict[str, Any] = {
        "artifact_path": str(path),
        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
    }
    parsed = maybe_json(path)
    record["parsed_as_json"] = parsed is not None
    if parsed is not None:
        record["json_content"] = parsed
    return record


def ms(ns: int | float) -> float:
    return ns / 1_000_000


def write_markdown(path: Path, summary: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    rounds = summary["aggregate_summary_ms"]
    combined = rounds["combined_per_clip_18_sample_medians"]
    lines = [
        f"# Public full-clip Go/dav1d refresh: {summary['variant']}",
        "",
        f"Measurement date: {summary['measurement_date']}.",
        "",
        "| Round | Go cold IVF sum (ms) | dav1d sum (ms) | Ratio |",
        "| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |",
    ]
    for key in ("round1", "round2"):
        entry = rounds[key]
        lines.append(f"| {key} | {entry['go_cold_ivf']:.3f} | {entry['dav1d']:.3f} | {entry['ratio']:.3f}× |")
    lines.extend([
        f"| Combined per-clip medians | {combined['go_cold_ivf']:.3f} | {combined['dav1d']:.3f} | {combined['ratio']:.3f}× |",
        "",
        "Combined values use the mean of each clip's middle pair across 18 samples. The aggregate is the sum of those per-clip medians. The two serialized rounds reverse backend order, but samples remain clustered; no paired-significance claim is made.",
        "",
        "Go's cold `NewDecoderFromIVF` timing includes IVF parsing and packet-payload copies. The C helper parses IVF records over preloaded bytes and wraps packet slices without copying them. The Go pre-parsed-payload and warm-reset paths are diagnostics and are excluded from the primary ratio.",
        "",
        "All 18 Go IVF outputs, Go payload-constructor outputs, and dav1d outputs matched their stream-MD5 sidecars in both rounds. This is a public-API comparison; it does not isolate language or SIMD speed.",
        "",
        "## Per-clip combined medians",
        "",
        "| Clip | Frames | Go cold IVF (ms) | dav1d (ms) | Go/dav1d |",
        "| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |",
    ])
    for name, row in sorted(summary["combined_18_sample_per_clip_medians"].items()):
        lines.append(
            f"| {name} | {row['frames']} | {ms(row['go_cold_ivf_median_18_ns']):.3f} | "
            f"{ms(row['dav1d_median_18_ns']):.3f} | {row['go_over_dav1d_ratio']:.3f}× |"
        )
    lines.extend([
        "",
        f"Installed dav1d runtime: {summary['environment']['dav1d_runtime_version']}; source checkout and binary provenance flags: "
        f"{summary['environment']['dav1d_source_checkout_commit_verified']} / {summary['environment']['dav1d_binary_provenance_verified']}.",
        "",
        "Raw logs, commands, input manifests, and checksums are preserved next to this report.",
        "",
    ])
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--run-dir", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--variant", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--go-binary", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--dav1d-helper", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--source-manifest", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--provenance", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--corpus-dir", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_dir = args.run_dir.resolve()
    source_root = args.source_root.resolve()
    go_binary = args.go_binary.resolve()
    helper = args.dav1d_helper.resolve()
    corpus_dir = args.corpus_dir.resolve()
    source_manifest = args.source_manifest.resolve()
    provenance = args.provenance.resolve()

    require(run_dir.is_dir(), f"run directory missing: {run_dir}")
    require(go_binary.is_file() and go_binary.stat().st_mode & 0o111, f"Go test binary missing or not executable: {go_binary}")
    require(helper.is_file() and helper.stat().st_mode & 0o111, f"dav1d helper missing or not executable: {helper}")
    require(source_manifest.is_file(), f"source manifest missing: {source_manifest}")
    require(provenance.is_file(), f"provenance file missing: {provenance}")
    require(corpus_dir.is_dir(), f"corpus directory missing: {corpus_dir}")

    ivf_paths = sorted(corpus_dir.glob("*.ivf"))
    names = [path.stem for path in ivf_paths]
    expected_names = set(names)
    require(len(names) == EXPECTED_CLIPS, f"expected 18 corpus IVF files, got {len(names)}")
    require(len(expected_names) == len(names), "duplicate corpus clip names")
    for ivf in ivf_paths:
        require(ivf.with_suffix(".md5").is_file(), f"missing sidecar for {ivf.name}")

    go_r1, md5_r1 = parse_go_log(run_dir / "round1-go.log", expected_names)
    c_meta_r1, c_r1 = parse_c_log(run_dir / "round1-dav1d.jsonl", expected_names)
    go_r2, md5_r2 = parse_go_log(run_dir / "round2-go.log", expected_names)
    c_meta_r2, c_r2 = parse_c_log(run_dir / "round2-dav1d.jsonl", expected_names)
    require(md5_r1 == md5_r2, "Go preflight MD5s differ across rounds")
    require(c_meta_r1 == c_meta_r2, "dav1d metadata differs across rounds")

    per1, sums1 = round_data(go_r1, c_r1, md5_r1)
    per2, sums2 = round_data(go_r2, c_r2, md5_r2)
    for name in sorted(expected_names):
        require(per1[name]["ivf_sha256"] == per2[name]["ivf_sha256"], f"{name}: IVF SHA-256 differs across rounds")
        require(per1[name]["sidecar_md5"] == per2[name]["sidecar_md5"], f"{name}: sidecar MD5 differs across rounds")

    combined: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for name in sorted(expected_names):
        a, b = per1[name], per2[name]
        def combined_median(field: str) -> int | float:
            return statistics.median(a[field] + b[field])
        go_cold = combined_median("go_cold_ivf_samples_ns")
        dav1d = combined_median("dav1d_samples_ns")
        combined[name] = {
            "frames": FRAMES_PER_CLIP,
            "go_cold_ivf_median_18_ns": go_cold,
            "dav1d_median_18_ns": dav1d,
            "go_over_dav1d_ratio": go_cold / dav1d,
            "go_cold_preparsed_payload_median_18_ns": combined_median("go_cold_preparsed_payload_samples_ns"),
            "go_warm_reset_median_18_ns": combined_median("go_warm_reset_samples_ns"),
            "ivf_sha256": a["ivf_sha256"],
            "sidecar_md5": a["sidecar_md5"],
        }

    combined_sums = {
        "go_cold_ivf": sum(row["go_cold_ivf_median_18_ns"] for row in combined.values()),
        "dav1d": sum(row["dav1d_median_18_ns"] for row in combined.values()),
        "go_cold_preparsed_payload": sum(row["go_cold_preparsed_payload_median_18_ns"] for row in combined.values()),
        "go_warm_reset": sum(row["go_warm_reset_median_18_ns"] for row in combined.values()),
    }

    raw_artifacts = {
        "round1_go": run_record(run_dir, "round1-go.log"),
        "round1_dav1d": run_record(run_dir, "round1-dav1d.jsonl"),
        "round2_dav1d": run_record(run_dir, "round2-dav1d.jsonl"),
        "round2_go": run_record(run_dir, "round2-go.log"),
        "environment": run_record(run_dir, "environment.txt"),
        "commands": run_record(run_dir, "commands.txt"),
        "run_events": run_record(run_dir, "run-events.tsv"),
    }

    runtime = runtime_dav1d_info(helper)
    meta = c_meta_r1
    events = (run_dir / "run-events.tsv").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    require(len(events) == 5, "expected four completed backend events plus TSV header")
    require([line.split("\t", 2)[:2] for line in events[1:]] == [
        ["round1", "go"], ["round1", "dav1d"], ["round2", "dav1d"], ["round2", "go"]
    ], "run event order is not Go→dav1d then dav1d→Go")
    for event in events[1:]:
        require(event.rsplit("\t", 1)[-1] == "0", f"nonzero backend exit in event: {event}")

    manifest_record = copy_record(source_manifest, run_dir)
    provenance_record = copy_record(provenance, run_dir)
    for line in (run_dir / "environment.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if line.startswith("source_manifest_input="):
            manifest_record["input_path"] = line.partition("=")[2]
        elif line.startswith("provenance_input="):
            provenance_record["input_path"] = line.partition("=")[2]
    stat_before = stat_after = "unknown"
    sha_before = sha_after = "unknown"
    helper_stat_before = helper_stat_after = "unknown"
    helper_sha_before = helper_sha_after = "unknown"
    library_path_before = library_path_after = "unknown"
    library_sha_before = library_sha_after = "unknown"
    for line in (run_dir / "environment.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if line.startswith("go_binary_stat_before="):
            stat_before = line.partition("=")[2]
        elif line.startswith("go_binary_stat_after="):
            stat_after = line.partition("=")[2]
        elif line.startswith("go_binary_sha256_before="):
            sha_before = line.partition("=")[2]
